title: Historical target performance proof required current-dev package-source ancestry

source_observation.environment: Exact immutable 2.5.5 archive on Factorio 2.0.77 under the current canonical performance executor
source_observation.fact: The 2.5.5 historical campaign binds source commit 689940f436b004cf4e5981f1944ddb04eaa17367, while the final dual-parent release record binds 1def5da0d0791149770f84d8bbc4c164c426b7ce. Neither is a dev ancestor, but their package roots have no differences and both independently produce the exact released content SHA-256 047B3442067FEA6D43EEE8DE4C79BE6FD265B92A059B546F6EC4D5C986CCF154. The current runner rejected the proof before Factorio launch solely because it required dev ancestry.

reproducer.expected: A current-source executor accepts a historical target only when the exact archive, campaign identity, declared campaign source, and released source are package-root equivalent; current campaigns retain their ancestor and dirty-tree checks.
reproducer.observed: The runner rejected the immutable legacy target before execution with 'Package source commit is not an ancestor of the current branch.'

stable_id_and_migration_impact: none; immutable historical target source-authority interpretation only
